Nike, Sephora, Target, Walmart, Wayfair, Fenty, Steve Madden are live. US summer launch confirmed. UCP ecosystem at 5,294 stores, +30% MoM.
momentum_angles.glance_counter_angle: Universal Cart is the most powerful cross-surface cart ever built — and it still requires at least one Google surface to be open. Glance's D0 feed operates before Search, Gmail, YouTube, or Gemini launches. The 'universal' in Universal Cart has a prerequisite: app-open.

momentum_angles.angle: Platform race to own agentic checkout (Klarna/ChatGPT, Amazon Alexa for Shopping, Meta Hatch)
momentum_angles.coverage_summary: Three platforms launched major agentic checkout products this week. Klarna brought 100M products with live prices into ChatGPT. Amazon retired Rufus and launched Alexa for Shopping with 'Buy for Me'. Meta Hatch is in testing with DoorDash, Reddit, and Outlook integration. Every publication is framing this as the checkout layer war.
momentum_angles.glance_counter_angle: All three launches are racing to own the last step. Glance owns the first step — product discovery before any of these agents are invoked. The checkout war is a D+1 problem. Glance is the only D0 player.

momentum_angles.angle: WWDC 2026 preview / Apple Siri 2.0 commerce capabilities
momentum_angles.coverage_summary: WWDC June 8 is generating pre-event coverage across all publications. Siri 2.0 with chatbot redesign, multi-step task handling, DoorDash ordering via voice, and third-party AI Extensions (Claude, Gemini) are the expected headlines. Commerce analysts are framing this as Apple finally entering agentic commerce.
momentum_angles.glance_counter_angle: Siri 2.0 voice commerce requires a wake word, a verbal intent, and an iPhone. Glance's lockscreen delivers ambient product discovery without any of these prerequisites — and on Android, which is the dominant global OS. WWDC is the ideal moment to publish the Android-first ambient commerce counterpoint.
